gizmo.title: Stripe buy button
gizmo.description: Sell a product or take a donation with a Stripe Buy Button. Stripe hosts the checkout.

configure.title: Buy button ID
configure.description: From the Stripe dashboard: Payment Links, then Buy button. Starts with buy_btn_

configure.title: Publishable key
configure.description: Starts with pk_live_ or pk_test_. Never paste a secret key (sk_) here

configure.title: Payment Link (fallback)
configure.description: The https://buy.stripe.com/ link for the same product. Shown when the button can't load, and works anywhere the page goes
